info.name: OGz Studios — Full API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for every API route in the OGz Studios platform.

## Quick start

1. Import this file: **File → Import → Upload Files** (or drag-drop).
2. Import the environment: `openclaw.postman_environment.json` (in the same folder).
3. Activate the environment (top-right dropdown → **OGz Studios — Local**).
4. Set `webhook_secret` in the environment (paste the value of `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` from `.env.local`).
5. Start the dev server: `pnpm --filter web dev`.
6. Click any request and hit **Send**.

## What's auto-handled

The collection-level pre-request script signs every request that has a body with HMAC-SHA256 — you don't have to compute headers yourself. It also auto-generates a fresh `x-n8n-request-id` and `x-n8n-timestamp` per call.

## Folder structure

- **00 — Health** — sanity checks (no auth)
- **01 — Negative tests** — security boundary checks (should FAIL)
- **02 — CEO** — classify + confidence-gate (with all 7 request_types and confidence modes)
- **03 — COO** — build-branddna, compile-caption-context, score-confidence
- **04 — CCO** — qc with happy path and edge cases
- **05 — DeepSeek** — generate (8 / 20 / 1 / Ramadan / watermarked)
- **06 — Memory Controller** — drain queue scenarios
- **07 — n8n status callbacks** — every event_type variant
- **08 — Stubs (501)** — Stripe, Correction (placeholders)
- **09 — Admin Copilot** — management / tech / production / unknown
- **10 — Admin Auth** — login / logout (cookie-based, no HMAC)

## Reference docs

- `docs/api/agents-and-memory.md` — request/response shapes
- `docs/n8n-integration.md` — HMAC recipe + flow walkthroughs
- `docs/db/database-guide.md` — what gets written where
